intro1: In the dwarf city of Karadrak-zarar,
intro2: after frustrating attempts by the dwarves to explore
intro3: submerged caves and find minerals that had become rare on the surface,
intro4: they finally found a solution: using arcane magic,
intro5: some available materials and the advanced technology of their
intro6: civilization (you were expecting me to mention element X, weren't you?).
intro7: They finally created the Golems, beings with a single purpose:
intro8: explore underwater caves and face the dangers that lie
intro9: at every step to bring back to the world the ancient glory that was lost.
jumptext2: It would be cool to reach those things up high
jumptext3: If it weren't for the arrow I took to the knee...
jumptext4: I need to stop with the midnight snacks.
jumptext5: I'll only be able to fly when the water density is greater than 3
jumptext6: I think we've seen this isn't going anywhere, right?
jumptext7: What are you trying to do?
